propositions: Four agentic criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) produced zero findings across ~7,900 runs due to inadequate trigger vocabulary, wasting agentic executions.
A deterministic pre-filter gate must skip plans where the criterion's subject vocabulary is entirely absent, while firing plans proceed unchanged through the existing LLM router per ADR 0034.

T13 and T14 use text_all regex conjunction and file_impact glob/reason matching; removal-rationale and asserted-capability use parallel leaf-gated rules with file_impact_reason_re matching author-declared removal work.
asserted-capability fires only when both text_all legs (module-ref and capability-verb) match, preventing single-leg false positives.
Skip recording must surface every not-fired gate in coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id with rule name, visible in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar.
Existing T5a/T5d/T7/T12 overlay rules must be migrated to DetGateRule objects with identical fire/no-fire behavior verified by test.
